questions.question: Who among the following wrote the book "Hind Swaraj"?
questions.hint: Hind Swaraj or Indian Home Rule is a book written by Mohandas K. Gandhi in 1909.

questions.question: Which article of the Indian Constitution is related to the Equality before law?
questions.hint: Article 14 of the Constitution of India provides for equality before law or the equal protection of the laws.

questions.question: The value of cos 0° + sin 90° is:
Which is the largest gland in the human body?
questions.hint: The liver is the largest gland in the human body.

questions.question: In which year did the Battle of Plassey take place?
questions.hint: The Battle of Plassey was fought on June 23, 1757.

questions.question: Who was the first Governor-General of Bengal?
questions.hint: Warren Hastings became the first Governor-General of Bengal in 1773.

questions.question: What is the SI unit of pressure?
questions.hint: Pascal (Pa) is the SI unit of pressure, equivalent to one newton per square meter.

questions.question: Which acid is primarily present in vinegar?
questions.hint: Vinegar is a liquid consisting of about 5–20% acetic acid.

questions.question: Sound waves cannot travel through which of the following media?
questions.hint: Sound is a mechanical wave and requires a physical medium to propagate; it cannot travel through a vacuum.

questions.question: What is the official currency of Japan?
questions.hint: The Yen is the official currency of Japan.

questions.question: Fundamental Duties were added to the Indian Constitution by which amendment?
questions.hint: Fundamental Duties were incorporated into Part IV-A by the 42nd Constitutional Amendment Act of 1976.

questions.question: On which date is World Environment Day celebrated globally?
questions.hint: World Environment Day is celebrated annually on June 5 to raise global awareness of environmental issues.

questions.question: The deficiency of Vitamin C in the human body leads to which disease?
questions.hint: Scurvy is caused by a lack of Vitamin C (ascorbic acid) in the diet.

questions.question: What is the capital city of Australia?
questions.hint: Canberra is the federal capital of Australia.
